title: Three links to one business (Google Maps, a listing page, a website) resolve to one business with one Google place
steps: S1: Run the link-kind domain tests: judgeLinks on a Google link, a listing page link and a website link.
S2: Run the Google link tests: parse and match of the three real links of the test case.
S3: Run the listing page tests: the business node of a listing page and its name hint.
expect: S1: social, listing, website and Google links are told apart; duplicates and a second Google link are judged, not merged.
S2: the three real links of the test case give one place; match never guesses.
S3: the listing page gives the business name, address, phone and geo, never the Organization.
fence: Pure domain functions, no network and no Postgres

tests: match: a place id or cid is exact
the three real links of the test case
the business node of a listing page
